I couldn't measure anything for task 47: I have no offline seconds, no control seconds and no raid result. I changed nothing in the game and shipped nothing.

I ran the test script `tools/handoff/console/notes/47-offline-test.mjs` with `node`, and the command was refused with "This command requires approval". Two earlier runs hit the same wall. This is the third attempt, and I added it to the notes.

An alarm for this task is already in `alarms.md`, so I didn't add another.

Reading the code only, I expect the offline link to land under 15 s. The worst case is a room wifi that swallows the lookups instead of failing them. Then host and player 2 could each wait the full 5 s, about 10 s plus the link itself. If a real run shows over 15 s, the fix is to cut the wait to about 1 s for the same-PC arcade link only.

Someone with `node` permission needs to run `node tools/handoff/console/notes/47-offline-test.mjs offline` three times, then `control` three times.
